scientific_role: Repair the upstream finite-distance opportunity population by removing the v094h requirement for positive infinity-sky footprint intersection, while preserving frozen v094h exposure eligibility and exposure-to-solution association and using independently reconstructed exposure/subexposure timing.

population.source_universe: same 139539 APPLAUSE DR4 exposures used by v094h
population.site_identity: same v094h normalized non-empty site_name; distinct sites only; no minimum distance cutoff
population.solution_association: exact v094h deterministic association: valid scan filename + valid STC polygon; choose smallest separation between parent exposure ra_icrs/dec_icrs and solution center; ties prefer larger num_xmatch then smaller solution_id; if fov1/fov2 exist require separation <= max(1 deg, 0.75*hypot(fov1,fov2)).
population.digital_footprint_change: Each side retains its own valid associated STC polygon. Positive intersection between the two infinity-sky polygons is diagnostic only and is NOT an inclusion criterion.

timing.source: frozen v094d exposure_full + exposure_sub_full as bound by v094q provenance
timing.multi_sub_rule: num_sub>1 requires exactly num_sub rows, unique subexposure IDs/numbers, valid start<end, and non-overlapping subfragments.
timing.single_sub_rule: num_sub<=1 uses parent exposure ut_start/ut_end provisionally.
timing.full_population_replay: For all otherwise-v094h-eligible exposures, independently reconstructed interval sets must match v094d master fragment_intervals_json to 1 ms before temporal pairing.
timing.primary_pair_metric: minimum continuous-fragment gap; zero for positive-duration fragment overlap

interpretation: Outcome-informed methodology repair after r3d, not a new confirmatory candidate search. Newly retained rows remain metadata-level opportunities until corrected geometry/synthetic validation.
stop_rule: STOP after v094s census; do not read source catalogues or run the real matcher.
